behavior.initialLoad: Do not render Empty before the first request settles; use Loading or Skeleton to prevent false-empty flicker.
behavior.partialFailure: Replace only the failed region. Do not blank a whole page when unaffected content remains usable.
behavior.retry: Preserve user input, filters and context; prevent duplicate requests while retrying and restore focus to a meaningful target after success.
behavior.dynamicAnnouncement: Use aria-live=polite/status only when the empty result appears after a user action. Do not make a static initial empty state noisy.
behavior.focus: Do not move focus to decorative illustration or empty copy. Keep focus on the initiating control or move it to the single recovery action only when that improves task continuation.

selectionRules.TextOnly: Compact card, table cell or narrow local region; no illustration.
selectionRules.Empty: The system or region has no records yet.
selectionRules.NotFound: Existing data may exist, but current search/filter returns no match.
selectionRules.NoPermission: Access control prevents viewing; do not imply that protected data exists.
selectionRules.Error: A request or rendering operation failed and can be retried.
selectionRules.NoChart: A chart has no plottable series for the current scope; keep axes/legend only when they still explain the state.

constraints: Use at most one action and render it with the shared Medium Button component.
Show Action=Button only when the action exists and can be executed in the current context.
Do not use Empty for Loading, success confirmation, destructive warnings or form validation.
Do not duplicate the same message with Toast, Alert or Notification in the same region.
Illustrations are decorative when title and description already express the state; use empty alt text.
Do not scale the 100px illustration above its authored size merely to fill a large container.
Long copy wraps within 240px; the component height follows content and must never be fixed with clipping.
